name: Debtors
overview: Scripture teaches that being a debtor carries spiritual and practical implications, emphasizing the importance of wise stewardship and integrity. The wicked borrow without repaying, while the righteous show mercy and give generously, reflecting godly character (Psalms 37:21). Borrowing places one in a position of servitude to the lender, highlighting the need for caution and planning, as illustrated by the call to count the cost before committing (Proverbs 22:7; Luke 14:28). Ultimately, believers are exhorted to owe nothing except love, fulfilling the law through mutual care rather than financial bondage (Romans 13:8), recognizing that divided loyalties between God and wealth are incompatible (Matthew 6:24).
